```yaml
name: Sync AI connector docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Airbyte repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: airbyte
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout Airbyte AI Connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          path: ai-connectors
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Sync AI connector documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SRC_DIR=ai-connectors
          DEST_DIR=airbyte/docs/ai-agents/connectors
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          shopt -s nullglob
          for dir in "$SRC_DIR"/*/; do
            md_files=("$dir"*.md)
            if [ ${#md_files[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
              cp "${md_files[@]}" "$DEST_DIR"
            fi
          done
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: sync AI connector docs'
          title: 'chore: sync AI connector docs'
          body: |
            This PR syncs AI connector documentation from airbyte-ai-connectors.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          base: main
          labels: documentation, auto-merge
          delete-branch: true
```
